metadata.name: DecryptAccountData
metadata.description: This API is used to get decrypted Account and Card details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: At least one account identifier is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: 0 = Then Show Full CardNumber 1 = Then Show Full SSN 2 = Then Show Full CardNumber and SSN 3 = Then Show Bank Account Number 4 = Then Show Full CardNumber and CVV 6 = Then Show NameOnCard , CVV , CardExpiry, CardNumber 7 = Then Show PayeeAccountNumber in Clear 8 = Then Show Mastercard VirtualCard Number 11 = Then Show Loan Account Number 14 = Then Show Tax Identification Number

request_fields.name: BankName
request_fields.description: MethodName of the Bank which you get in the response of ManageBankAccount API while adding the Bank. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:1153783 Condition: If DecisionFlag = 3 then BankName is required Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: OriginatorPaymentID
request_fields.description: This is the ID created at the issuer end. This ID will be acting as lifecycle ID. Condition: For Balance Transfer If DecisionFlag = 7 then OriginatorPaymentID is required. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 121730 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: LoanID
request_fields.description: LoanID Condition: If DecisionFlag = 11 then LoanID is required Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: Statementdate
request_fields.description: Date when statement will be generated Valid Values:1215090000 Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: CardSequenceNumber
request_fields.description: This tag reflects the Sequence Number of the Card. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2 Condition: 1.If Dual Card Support is Yes on Program, then only this field will be considered else no validation should be applied on this tag. 2.If no value is passed in the field, then as per system existing behavior card details will be returned.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: BankAccountNumber
children.description: Bank Account Number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:0000000001234567891 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CVV
children.description: 3 Digit security number printed on back side of the card. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:456 Allowable Values: 3

children.name: SSN
children.description: Card holder's Social Security Number Format:AAAGGSSSS Example:078051120 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: PayeeAccountNumber
children.description: Payee’s Account Number. (Card No. / Loan Account Number) Valid Values: 0-9 Example:7314145404 Condition: For Balance Transfer Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CoApplicantSSN
children.description: Co-Applicant's Social Security Number Format:AAAGGSSSS Example:078051120 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: CosignerSSN
children.description: Cosigner's Social Security Number Format:AAAGGSSSS Example:078051120 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: CardExpirationDate
children.description: Date when Card is supposed to be expired. Format: MM/YYYY Example: 01/2024 Allowable Values: 7

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be printed on the card. Example:John J Allowable Values: 50

children.name: FourDigitsCSC
children.description: 4 Digit security number printed on back side of the card. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:4567 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: BusinessName
children.description: Company Name (Business Name) Example: ALPHA CORP Allowable Values: 100

children.name: CardArtID
children.description: CardArtID Valid Values:0-9 Example:02 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TaxIdentificationNumber
children.description: Cardholder's Tax Identification Number. Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Format: xxxxxx Example: 489657458 Allowable Values: 10
